entities.summary: Masoud Hosseini Khamenei, also known as Mohsen Khamenei, is an Iranian Twelver Shia cleric. A member of the Khamenei family, he is the third son of the second Iranian supreme leader Ali Khamenei, and the younger brother of the third and current supreme leader, Mojtaba Khamenei.
